items.title: Tom McIntosh — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: ours, Yusef Lateef, was… Not Yusef Lateef…what was his name?

ctx.x: Moody, he had made me the director of his group. I was very happy to be able to lift him out of the dives to high places. Then I saw something wrong. I went to him and I said, “Moody, your loyalty is wonderful but you’re hurting the band.” I said, “Yeah, the bass player, you like him because he has the sound of a drum but he’s playing the wrong notes.” Musically, spiritually, you hear the wrong note and the bottom destroys everything.
